sections.heading: 1. Standing back extension
lines: ① Feet hip-width, hands on your lower back.
② Push hips forward, lean gently back.
③ Hold 2 sec × 5 reps, every break.
④ Lift close to your body, turn with your feet.

sections.heading: 2. Stop if…
lines: Pain or tingling spreads down a leg,
or it feels weak — stop and get advice.

caption:
Lift, turn, stack, repeat. After a full shift of boxes, Lulu's lower back feels heavy by knock-off.

The further a box is from your body, the more your back works. Bend at the hips and knees, hold the load close, and turn with your feet rather than twisting. Remedial massage can help tight muscles feel easier, but it complements strength work and good lifting habits rather than replacing them.

Hybi's 1-minute reset: standing back extension, hold 2 seconds, 5 reps, every break.

Tingling or weakness down a leg, or no change after two weeks, is worth an assessment. Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio
